data.one_liner: A sliding up panel widget to show or hide content.
data.what_it_does: Provides a sliding up panel widget that can be dragged, clicked, or controlled programmatically to show or hide content. Supports custom anchor points, bounds, drag callbacks, and status change listeners.
use_when: You need a bottom sheet or sliding up panel in your UI to display extra details or lists.
You want to allow users to drag, tap, or programmatically expand and collapse a panel.
avoid_when: You require complex platform-specific bottom sheet behaviors not supported by the widget.
strengths: Easy to integrate into standard Stack layouts
Provides fine-grained drag listeners and controller management
Supports custom upper and lower bounds
weaknesses: Limited documentation beyond the basic README example
Manual controller management required for complex transitions
data.minimal_example:
SlidingUpPanelWidget(
  child: Container(
    child: Text('Panel Content'),
  ),
  controlHeight: 50.0,
  anchor: 0.4,
  panelController: panelController,
)
